subject.title: fix(mcp): normalize disabled:true to enabled:false in canonicalizeConfiguredMcpServer

question: Should `mcp.servers.<name>.disabled` become a permanently supported public alias, or should existing occurrences be migrated once to canonical `enabled` by Doctor?
rationale: The choice changes a public, upgrade-sensitive config contract across schema validation, Control UI, CLI, Doctor, embedded runtime, and external runtime projections; repository policy favors canonical runtime shapes but maintainers may intentionally sponsor an alias.

options.title: Doctor-only migration
options.body: Keep `enabled` as the only runtime field and repair raw `disabled` entries into canonical config through `openclaw doctor --fix`.

options.title: Support a permanent alias
options.body: Accept `disabled` as public API and align exported types, schema/help, docs, UI, conflict semantics, Doctor, and every runtime projection.

recommendation.title: Doctor-only migration
recommendation.body: Keep `enabled` as the only runtime field and repair raw `disabled` entries into canonical config through `openclaw doctor --fix`.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the MCP operator-control, config-normalization, and runtime ownership work associated with their commits.
